title: Rendering, escaping and output ownership
summary: render and renderTo share the same segment resolution, formatting and render-policy semantics. render returns a String; renderTo submits each rendered segment to a caller-owned charOut sink and does not close or flush it.
json_boundary: JSON mode escapes substituted JSON string content, including all control bytes 00x..1fx, quote and backslash. It does not construct or validate a complete JSON document.
invariants: The caller owns sink lifecycle and sink semantics.
Streaming is a destination choice, not a second template execution model.
Plain output makes no escaping claim.
